Type: embossed ceramic plant pot
Use: holding an indoor plant; on a shelf, table or windowsill in a living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, art deco, traditional
Materials: reactive glazed stoneware with embossed relief, ribbed interior
Colors: deep cobalt blue, light blue highlights, cream
Shape: rounded cylinder slightly tapered at the base, all-over fan motif, medium size
Feel: rich, vibrant, crafted
Goes with: white walls, brass, warm wood, green plants; bohemian or eclectic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Medium Fan-Embossed Planter, 6"H, Blue
product.description: This eye-catching planter is the perfect vessel for a plant, flower, or other greenery of your choice, or you can choose to keep it empty or use it to display other items in your home. The blue color will look great in any room or outdoor space. 6.7" diameter x 6"H; 6" interior diameter 100% ceramic stoneware This natural stoneware pot is perfect for showing off your favorite flower or plant and includes a drainage hole. With an embossed fan pattern in blue glaze, there's no wrong way to display this classic pot. Fill it with your favorite plant or keep it empty. No assembly required Hand wash with a wet cloth.
